empty_cargo_if_still_undeliverable.description: Stage 2 (optional): if a truck THIS mod already recovered is flagged cannot-deliver again with the same load on a later day, empty that load into the game's storage routing (real storages in global-priority order, shipyard overflow last) via the game's own cargo discard (0.1 Unity, charged by the game on success). Default OFF: stage 1 recovery alone preserves every load aboard its truck.

enabled.description: Master switch for QoS Vehicle Recovery. Ships OFF: install it, look around, then turn it on when you want daily stuck-truck rescue to start.

log_actions.description: Write one log line per scheduled action (truck, reason, cargo, predicted cost and outcome).

max_recoveries_per_day.description: Cap on recoveries scheduled per in-game day across all trucks. Keeps the Unity spend gradual and the log readable.

min_navigation_failed_streak.description: A truck counts as navigation-stuck when the game's repeated-failure flag is set, or when it is stuck with at least this many consecutive navigation failures. Higher = fewer, more certain rescues.

recover_cannot_deliver.description: Stage 1 for trucks flagged cannot-deliver (the game's own sustained signal that a loaded truck has nowhere to take its cargo).

recover_navigation_stuck.description: Stage 1 for trucks stuck on navigation (wedged pathing), whether loaded or empty.

unity_reserve_floor.description: Never schedule a recovery or stage-2 empty if the Unity balance after its cost would fall below this many Upoints. The game's own affordability check also always applies.
